title: Settings
description: From an Asset: some or all of its settings, each an explicit end state. A setting left out is unchanged. The Asset sends one when it starts or reconnects, with every setting it knows; when it changes a setting itself; and to confirm a settings_change, which request_id names. A Task of kind settings is confirmed by its report.status kind task instead. Each setting keeps the value from its newest report by time, then by event order; an older report never replaces a newer value.
